question: What initial yogic focus begins the sequence of experiential signs described to the beloved?
premises: The practice begins with the root wheel.
This is identified as the first stage of practice.
inference: Practice directed at the root wheel constitutes the first stage in this process.
uncertainties: The fused form mūlacakrantu is read as mūlacakram tu.
The fused form yadānyabhyasate is read as yadā abhyasate.
plain_english: O Beloved, first, when one practices upon the root wheel...
